name: WonderClip
desc: Alibaba Cloud platform for AI short drama and marketing video
desc_zh: 阿里云做短漫剧和营销视频的 AI 平台
solves: A short video needs a script, storyboard, shots and edit; upload a script and the platform runs the whole chain.
solves_zh: 做一条短视频要剧本、分镜、拍摄和剪辑，上传剧本这条链路它一口气跑完。
best_for: You have a script for a short drama or an ad and need consistent characters across every shot.
best_for_zh: 手上有一个短剧或广告剧本，需要每个镜头里的人物都长得一样。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.aliyun.com/product/monthly/2026-may (阿里云产品五月刊), https://www.aliy）。 In-window: the official product-dynamics record stamps the new product at 2026.05.19 (正式商业化). Media put the public launch one day later — 新浪财经 published on 2026-05-21 that “昨日，阿里云正式发布全链路AI视频创作平台‘万镜一刻’（WonderClip），并即日起面向全行业开放”, i.e. 2026-05-20; the Alibaba Cloud May digest simply says 正式发布. The first-party 2026-05-19 stamp is used and the one-day gap is recorded here. English name WonderClip appears in Alibaba Cloud's own 新浪财经 post but not on the aliyun.com product page, so `name` keeps the Chinese spelling. Absent from the ledger. Runs on Alibaba's own models (Happy Horse, Wan, Qwen-image, Z-image) and offers storyboard, infinite-canvas and agent creation modes plus API delivery. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：阿里云官方账号发布的稿件写作「万镜一刻（WonderClip）」，产品页地址也是 wonderclip；按账本对中英双名产品的记法，英文名放 name，中文名放 name_zh。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.aliyun.com/product/news/29096
